sdss_options_menu_desc: Super Duper Skin Swapper mod options.
sdss_mini_icon_bg_desc: Adds a background to the skin mini-icon in inventory.
sdss_fast_preview_desc: Double clicking a skin will preview it instead of applying it.
sdss_page_buttons_max_desc:
Maximum number of pages buttons to show.
Leave this at the maximum unless your page numbers are being cut off.
sdss_dialog_welcome:
Welcome to Super Duper Skin Swapper.

Some old SDSS features are now provided by Optional Skin Attachments and Hide Duplicate Skins. SDSS still works without them, but some features will be unavailable.

Would you like to add these mods to the BLT download manager? You can also do this later from the SDSS options menu.
sdss_dialog_do_not_show_again: Do not show this message again
sdss_dl_osa_button_desc: Add Optional Skin Attachments to the BLT download manager.
sdss_dialog_install_osa: Optional Skin Attachments adds support for skin-included weapon attachments and legendary skin customization. Add it to the BLT download manager?
sdss_dl_hds_button_desc: Add Hide Duplicate Skins to the BLT download manager.
sdss_dialog_install_hds: Hide Duplicate Skins automatically hides duplicate weapon skins and keeps only the best versions visible. Add it to the BLT download manager?
sdss_osa_shortcut_button_desc: Go to Optional Skin Attachments settings.
sdss_hds_shortcut_button_desc: Go to Hide Duplicate Skins settings.
sdss_dialog_legend_reset:
Your weapon was reset to the default configuration because it uses legendary attachments without the corresponding skin.

You can download Optional Skin Attachments from the SDSS settings menu to customize legendary skins safely.
sdss_filter_safe_desc: Filter skins from a certain safe.
sdss_filter_weapon_desc: Filter skins based on weapon type.
